metadata.title: Legislative Posts and Offices
metadata.description: Structured records of constitutional, statutory, parliamentary and party positions in Indian legislatures.

posts.name: Speaker of the Lok Sabha
posts.description: The presiding officer of the Lok Sabha who conducts its proceedings and maintains order in the House.
qualifications: Must be a member of the Lok Sabha.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Normally continues until immediately before the first meeting of the next Lok Sabha, subject to constitutional provisions.
tenure_and_removal.removal: May be removed by a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members of the House.
tenure_and_removal.notice_period: At least fourteen days' notice is required for a resolution to remove the Speaker.

powers_and_functions: Presides over meetings of the Lok Sabha.
Maintains order and regulates proceedings.
Interprets and applies the Rules of Procedure of the Lok Sabha.
Decides whether a Bill is a Money Bill for the purposes of the Constitution.
Exercises powers under the Tenth Schedule, subject to judicial review.
Presides over joint sittings of Parliament.
limitations: Must act within the Constitution and the applicable rules of procedure.
Certain decisions are subject to judicial review.

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

posts.name: Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
posts.description: The presiding officer who performs the Speaker's functions when the Speaker's office is vacant or the Speaker is absent.
qualifications: Must be a member of the Lok Sabha.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Normally continues until immediately before the first meeting of the next Lok Sabha, subject to constitutional provisions.
tenure_and_removal.removal: May be removed by a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members.

powers_and_functions: Presides over the Lok Sabha in the absence of the Speaker.
Exercises the powers of the Speaker when presiding.
Performs duties assigned under the Rules of Procedure.
limitations: Does not ordinarily displace the Speaker while the Speaker is presiding.

posts.name: Leader of the House in the Lok Sabha
posts.description: The leader responsible for coordinating government business and representing the government's legislative priorities in the Lok Sabha.

appointment_or_selection.usual_convention: Generally the Prime Minister, if a member of the Lok Sabha, or a minister designated by the Prime Minister.

qualifications: The designated person is ordinarily a member of the Lok Sabha.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Generally linked to the government's designation and the person's parliamentary position.

powers_and_functions: Coordinates government business in the House.
Participates in decisions concerning the scheduling of government business.
Coordinates with the Speaker and other parliamentary leaders.
Represents the government's legislative programme.
limitations: Does not exercise the independent procedural powers of the Speaker.
Must comply with parliamentary rules and directions of the presiding officer.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

posts.name: Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha
posts.description: The recognized leader of the opposition in the Lok Sabha.

appointment_or_selection.basis: Recognition under the applicable statutory framework and parliamentary rules.

qualifications: Must be a member of the Lok Sabha.
Must satisfy the applicable recognition requirements.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Generally linked to recognition and continued membership of the House.

powers_and_functions: Leads the recognized opposition in the House.
Scrutinizes government policies and legislative proposals.
Participates in consultations and institutional processes where the office is included by law.
Provides an organized opposition perspective in parliamentary proceedings.
limitations: Does not possess the procedural authority of the Speaker.
Recognition is governed by the applicable legal and parliamentary framework.
legal_basis: Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977

references.title: Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977

posts.name: Chief Whip in the Lok Sabha
posts.description: A party position responsible for coordinating members and communicating party directions concerning House business and voting.
powers_and_functions: Coordinates attendance of party members.
Communicates party positions on legislative business.
Coordinates voting strategy.
Maintains communication between party leadership and members.
limitations: Does not independently preside over the House.
Party directions operate within the constitutional and legal framework, including the Tenth Schedule.
legal_basis: Political party rules and parliamentary practice

posts.name: Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: The Vice-President of India serves as the ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
qualifications: Must hold the office of Vice-President of India.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Co-terminus with the person's tenure as Vice-President, subject to constitutional provisions.

powers_and_functions: Presides over meetings of the Rajya Sabha.
Maintains order and regulates proceedings.
Interprets and applies the Rules of Procedure.
Exercises the procedural powers assigned to the Chairman.
Exercises powers under the Tenth Schedule, subject to judicial review.
limitations: Is not a member of the Rajya Sabha merely by virtue of being Chairman.
Cannot vote in the first instance but has a casting vote in the event of a tie.

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

posts.name: Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: The presiding officer elected by the Rajya Sabha from among its members.
qualifications: Must be a member of the Rajya Sabha.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Holds office until ceasing to be a member, resigning or being removed.
tenure_and_removal.removal: May be removed by a resolution of the Rajya Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members.

powers_and_functions: Presides over the Rajya Sabha when the Chairman is absent.
Performs the functions of the Chairman when the office is vacant.
Exercises presiding powers while conducting a sitting.
limitations: Exercises the powers of the presiding officer when acting in that capacity.

posts.name: Leader of the House in the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: The person designated to coordinate government business in the Rajya Sabha.

appointment_or_selection.usual_convention: A minister designated by the Prime Minister.

qualifications: Ordinarily a member of the Rajya Sabha.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Generally linked to government designation and parliamentary membership.

powers_and_functions: Coordinates government business in the Rajya Sabha.
Participates in scheduling and organizing House business.
Coordinates with the Chairman and opposition leadership.
limitations: Does not exercise the independent procedural powers of the Chairman.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

posts.name: Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: The recognized leader of the opposition in the Rajya Sabha.
qualifications: Must be a member of the Rajya Sabha.
Must satisfy applicable recognition requirements.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Generally linked to recognition and continued membership.

powers_and_functions: Leads the recognized opposition in the House.
Scrutinizes government policies and legislation.
Participates in consultations and institutional processes where provided by law.
limitations: Does not possess the procedural authority of the Chairman.
legal_basis: Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977

references.title: Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977

posts.name: Chief Whip in the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: A party position responsible for coordinating members and communicating party directions in the Rajya Sabha.
powers_and_functions: Coordinates attendance of party members.
Communicates party positions on House business.
Coordinates voting strategy.
Maintains communication between party leadership and members.
limitations: Does not independently preside over the House.
Party directions operate within the constitutional and legal framework.
legal_basis: Political party rules and parliamentary practice

posts.name: Member of the Lok Sabha
posts.description: A representative elected to the House of the People through parliamentary elections.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Eligible voters in the parliamentary constituency

qualifications: Must be a citizen of India.
Must satisfy the qualifications under Article 84 and applicable election law.
Must be at least 25 years of age.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Normally five years unless sooner dissolved.

powers_and_functions: Participates in making laws.
Votes on legislative and financial business.
Participates in debates and parliamentary proceedings.
Holds the Council of Ministers collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha.
Participates in parliamentary committees where appointed.
limitations: Subject to disqualification provisions under the Constitution and election laws.
Must comply with parliamentary rules and the Tenth Schedule.

posts.name: Member of the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: A representative of the States and Union Territories, or a nominated member, serving in the Council of States.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies for elected seats
appointment_or_selection.nomination_authority: President of India for nominated seats

qualifications: Must be a citizen of India.
Must satisfy the qualifications under Article 84 and applicable election law.
Must be at least 30 years of age.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Six years, with approximately one-third of members retiring every second year.

powers_and_functions: Participates in making laws.
Represents State and Union Territory interests.
Participates in constitutional amendment proceedings.
Reviews legislation and government policy.
Participates in parliamentary committees where appointed.
limitations: Money Bills cannot be introduced in the Rajya Sabha.
Its powers concerning Money Bills are limited by Article 109.

posts.name: Panel of Chairpersons of the Lok Sabha
posts.description: A panel of members nominated by the Speaker to preside over House sittings when required.
powers_and_functions: Presides over sittings when authorized and required.
Exercises the powers of the presiding officer while conducting the sitting.
limitations: Does not replace the constitutional office of Speaker or Deputy Speaker.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

details.individual_member_records: May be stored separately if required.

posts.name: Panel of Vice-Chairpersons of the Rajya Sabha
posts.description: A panel of members nominated to preside over Rajya Sabha sittings when the Chairman and Deputy Chairman are unavailable.
powers_and_functions: Presides over sittings when required under the applicable rules.
Exercises presiding powers while conducting the sitting.
limitations: Does not replace the offices of Chairman or Deputy Chairman.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

references.title: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Council of States

posts.name: Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: The presiding officer of a State Legislative Assembly.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Members of the State Legislative Assembly

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Assembly.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Normally continues until immediately before the first meeting of the next Assembly, subject to constitutional provisions.
tenure_and_removal.removal: By a resolution passed by a majority of all the then members of the Assembly.

powers_and_functions: Presides over Assembly sittings.
Maintains order and regulates proceedings.
Interprets the Assembly's rules of procedure.
Exercises powers under the Tenth Schedule, subject to judicial review.
Performs other duties assigned by the Constitution and Assembly rules.
limitations: Must act within the Constitution and applicable Assembly rules.

posts.name: Deputy Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: The presiding officer who performs the Speaker's functions when required.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Members of the State Legislative Assembly

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Assembly.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Subject to constitutional provisions concerning the office.
tenure_and_removal.removal: By a resolution passed by a majority of all the then members of the Assembly.

powers_and_functions: Presides over the Assembly when the Speaker is absent.
Performs the functions assigned under the Constitution and Assembly rules.
limitations: Exercises presiding powers when acting in that capacity.

posts.name: Leader of the House in the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: The person responsible for coordinating government business in the State Legislative Assembly.

appointment_or_selection.usual_convention: Generally the Chief Minister, if a member of the Assembly, or a designated minister.

powers_and_functions: Coordinates government business.
Participates in scheduling legislative business.
Coordinates with the Speaker and other House leaders.
limitations: Does not exercise the independent procedural powers of the Speaker.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure of the concerned State Legislative Assembly

references.title: Rules of Procedure of the concerned State Legislative Assembly

posts.name: Leader of the Opposition in the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: The recognized leader of the opposition in a State Legislative Assembly.

appointment_or_selection.authority: Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Assembly.
Must satisfy the applicable State recognition requirements.
powers_and_functions: Leads the recognized opposition.
Scrutinizes government policy and legislative proposals.
Participates in consultations and institutional processes where applicable.
limitations: Recognition requirements may differ between States.
legal_basis: Rules and directions of the State Legislative Assembly

references.title: Applicable State legislation and Assembly rules

posts.name: Chief Whip in the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: A party position responsible for coordinating party members and communicating party directions in the Assembly.
powers_and_functions: Coordinates attendance of party members.
Communicates party positions on legislative business.
Coordinates voting strategy.
limitations: Does not independently preside over the Assembly.
Party directions operate within the constitutional and legal framework.

posts.name: Chairman of the State Legislative Council
posts.description: The presiding officer elected by a State Legislative Council from among its members.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Members of the State Legislative Council

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Council.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Subject to membership, resignation and removal provisions.
tenure_and_removal.removal: By a resolution of the Council passed by a majority of all the then members.

powers_and_functions: Presides over Council sittings.
Maintains order and regulates proceedings.
Interprets and applies the Council's rules of procedure.
Performs duties assigned under the Constitution and Council rules.
limitations: Must act within the Constitution and applicable rules.

posts.name: Deputy Chairman of the State Legislative Council
posts.description: The presiding officer who performs the Chairman's functions when required.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Members of the State Legislative Council

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Council.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Subject to constitutional provisions concerning the office.
tenure_and_removal.removal: By a resolution passed by a majority of all the then members of the Council.

powers_and_functions: Presides over the Council when the Chairman is absent.
Performs functions assigned under the Constitution and Council rules.
limitations: Exercises presiding powers when acting in that capacity.

posts.name: Leader of the House in the State Legislative Council
posts.description: The person designated to coordinate government business in a State Legislative Council.

appointment_or_selection.usual_convention: A minister designated by the Chief Minister.

powers_and_functions: Coordinates government business in the Council.
Participates in scheduling and organizing House business.
Coordinates with the Chairman and other House leaders.
limitations: Does not exercise the independent procedural powers of the Chairman.
legal_basis: Rules of Procedure of the concerned State Legislative Council

references.title: Rules of Procedure of the concerned State Legislative Council

posts.name: Leader of the Opposition in the State Legislative Council
posts.description: The recognized leader of the opposition in a State Legislative Council.

appointment_or_selection.authority: Chairman of the State Legislative Council

qualifications: Must be a member of the State Legislative Council.
Must satisfy applicable State recognition requirements.
powers_and_functions: Leads the recognized opposition in the Council.
Scrutinizes government policy and legislative proposals.
Participates in consultations where applicable.
limitations: Recognition requirements may differ between States.
legal_basis: Rules and directions of the State Legislative Council

references.title: Applicable State legislation and Council rules

posts.name: Member of the State Legislative Assembly
posts.description: A representative directly elected to a State Legislative Assembly from an Assembly constituency.

appointment_or_selection.electorate: Eligible voters in the Assembly constituency

qualifications: Must be a citizen of India.
Must satisfy Article 173 and applicable election law.
Must be at least 25 years of age.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Normally five years unless sooner dissolved.

powers_and_functions: Participates in State lawmaking.
Votes on legislative and financial business.
Participates in debates and Assembly proceedings.
Holds the State Council of Ministers collectively responsible to the Assembly.
Participates in committees where appointed.
limitations: Subject to constitutional disqualification provisions and applicable election laws.
Must comply with Assembly rules and the Tenth Schedule.

posts.name: Member of the State Legislative Council
posts.description: A member of the upper House of a State Legislature, where such a Council exists.

electoral_categories: Members elected by the Legislative Assembly

qualifications: Must be a citizen of India.
Must satisfy Article 173 and applicable election law.
Must be at least 30 years of age.

tenure_and_removal.tenure: Six years, with approximately one-third of members retiring every second year.

powers_and_functions: Participates in State legislative proceedings.
Reviews and debates legislative proposals.
Participates in committees where appointed.
Exercises the Council's legislative powers under the Constitution.
limitations: The Council has limited powers in relation to Money Bills.
The Council can delay, but cannot permanently block, ordinary legislation passed by the Assembly.

details.availability: Only in States having a Legislative Council
